entry.summary:

This isn't a bug in the Mandelbrot math. The set is infinitely detailed, there's always more structure to see. The problem is in how computers store decimal numbers. JavaScript (like most languages) stores all numbers as 64-bit IEEE 754 doubles. This is just the standard format computers use for decimal numbers, and it gives you about 15 to 17 significant digits of precision.
